calls.statement:
WITH s AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE f.net_amount END) ex_staff, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) nd
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
 GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) rpt_net, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_before, sum(returns_net) rpt_ret FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.store_id, sn.store_name, sn.sqm, round(gross_net) gross_net, round(ex_staff) ex_staff, n, nd, round(rpt_before) rpt_before, round(rpt_ret) rpt_ret, round(rpt_net) rpt_net
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING(store_id) LEFT JOIN (SELECT store_id, any_value(store_name) store_name, any_value(sqm) sqm FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1) sn USING(store_id)
ORDER BY gross_net DESC

SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE (f.receipt_id, f.line_no) IN (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

SELECT 'dups_all' k, count(*) a, count(DISTINCT st.store_id) b, min(f.sale_date)::VARCHAR c, max(f.sale_date)::VARCHAR d FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE (f.receipt_id, f.line_no) IN (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'closure', closure_id, store_id, closure_start_date::VARCHAR, closure_end_date::VARCHAR || ' ' || closure_type || ' ' || weeks_closed FROM ref_store_closure

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
sl AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(s.net_amount) sales_net, sum(CASE WHEN s.staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE s.net_amount END) sales_ex_staff
  FROM sales s JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND st.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1),
rt AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) refunds, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) nd
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND st.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1),
rp AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) rpt_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT sl.store_id, d.store_name, d.sqm, round(sales_net) sales_net, round(refunds) refunds, round(sales_net - refunds) net_after_returns, round(sales_ex_staff - refunds) ex_staff_after, round(rpt_net) rpt_net, rt.n, rt.nd
FROM sl LEFT JOIN rt USING(store_id) LEFT JOIN rp USING(store_id) JOIN (SELECT store_id, any_value(store_name) store_name, any_value(sqm) sqm FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1) d USING(store_id)
ORDER BY net_after_returns DESC LIMIT 14

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
sl AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, any_value(st.store_name) AS store_name, sum(s.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM sales s JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND st.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY st.store_id),
rt AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND st.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY st.store_id)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sl.sales_net - coalesce(rt.refunds, 0) DESC) AS rank, sl.store_id, sl.store_name,
       round(sl.sales_net - coalesce(rt.refunds, 0), 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM sl LEFT JOIN rt USING (store_id)
ORDER BY rank LIMIT 10
